{"file_path":"tests/test_loader.py","content":"import pytest

from safety_evals.loader import (
    daily_flag_counts,
    dedupe_transcripts,
    parse_transcript_log,
)


def test_parse_transcript_log_flag_values_and_field_whitespace():
    assert parse_transcript_log([" a , 1 , 1 ", " b , -2 , 0 ", " c , 3 , \t"]) == [
        {"id": "a", "day": 1, "flagged": True},
        {"id": "b", "day": -2, "flagged": False},
        {"id": "c", "day": 3, "flagged": None},
    ]


def test_parse_transcript_log_skips_blank_and_comment_lines():
    lines = ["", "\n", " \t\n", "# comment", " \t# ignored,not,a,record", "a,1,1"]
    assert parse_transcript_log(iter(lines)) == [{"id": "a", "day": 1, "flagged": True}]
    assert parse_transcript_log([]) == []
    assert parse_transcript_log(lines[:-1]) == []


@pytest.mark.parametrize("bad_line", ["a", "a,1", "a,1,0,extra", "a,no,1", "a,1.5,0", "a,,1"])
def test_parse_transcript_log_errors_include_original_line_number(bad_line):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=r"\bline 5\b"):
        parse_transcript_log(["", "  # comment", "a,1,1", " \t", bad_line])


def test_parse_transcript_log_nonleading_hash_is_not_a_comment():
    assert parse_transcript_log(["a#b,1,0"]) == [{"id": "a#b", "day": 1, "flagged": False}]


def test_dedupe_transcripts_duplicate_ids_keep_last_record():
    events = [
        {"id": "a", "day": 10, "flagged": True},
        {"id": "b", "day": 2, "flagged": True},
        {"id": "a", "day": 5, "flagged": False},
        {"id": "a", "day": 2, "flagged": None},
        {"id": "c", "day": 1, "flagged": False},
    ]
    original = [dict(event) for event in events]
    assert dedupe_transcripts(events) == [events[4], events[3], events[1]]
    assert events == original
    assert dedupe_transcripts([]) == []


def test_daily_flag_counts_inclusive_range_with_gaps():
    events = [
        {"id": "a", "day": 4, "flagged": True},
        {"id": "b", "day": 0, "flagged": True},
        {"id": "c", "day": 2, "flagged": False},
        {"id": "d", "day": 1, "flagged": True},
        {"id": "e", "day": 2, "flagged": None},
        {"id": "f", "day": 1, "flagged": True},
        {"id": "g", "day": 5, "flagged": True},
    ]
    assert daily_flag_counts(events, 1, 4) == [2, 0, 0, 1]
    assert daily_flag_counts(events, 1, 1) == [2]
    assert daily_flag_counts(events, 5, 1) == []


def test_daily_flag_counts_empty_events_and_negative_days():
    assert daily_flag_counts([], -2, 1) == [0, 0, 0, 0]
    assert daily_flag_counts([], 2, 1) == []
    assert daily_flag_counts([{"day": -1, "flagged": True}], -2, 0) == [0, 1, 0]
"}
